newsitem.title: USA: Standard sees Q4 charges, net loss.
newsitem.headline: Standard sees Q4 charges, net loss.

text.p: Standard Microsystems Corp. said Tuesday it expects to record charges to its operations of approximately $5.5 to $7.0 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 1997 which ends Feb. 28, 1997.

Due to the charges and certain operating problems, the company said it expects to post a net loss for the fourth quarter which will be greater than the loss it incurred in its third quarter ended Nov. 30, 1996.

The company said it took steps recently to remain competitive, including cutting staff in its systems products division and in shared corporate resource units, and instituting furloughs in its components products division.
It said it took the steps because revenues of its systems products division continued to be below expectations and due to increasing price pressure from competitors in the Far East.

As a result of the severance costs associated with the staff cut, an inventory write-down of $3.0-$4.0 million and accrual of legal fees related to ongoing litigation, the company said it anticipates a combined charge of $5.5-$7.0 million against pre-tax earnings in the fourth quarter.
Standard Micro is a worldwide supplier of circuits and systems for the personal computer industry.
